title: Local AI Manager configuration v1
description: User-authored configuration for stable Local AI Manager commands. Command-line values override this file. The file MUST NOT contain credentials, tokens, proxy authorization, arbitrary environment variables, repository content, prompts, model responses, literal usernames/hostnames, device identifiers, or network identifiers.

schema_version.description: Major-version discriminator. Unknown major versions are rejected.

accept_safe_defaults.description: Equivalent to --yes. This cannot approve elevation, workspace trust, agent tools, policy exceptions, external-application removal, model deletion, or other protected/destructive actions.

manager_directory.description: User-local path using the literal ${HOME} token; literal usernames are forbidden.

manage_path.description: When true, use only a marker-owned reversible PATH change after consent.

allow_application_install.description: Permits planning official VS Code/Ollama installation. It does not grant elevation or installer-UI consent.

context_tokens.description: Requested alias and runtime context. Values below the product minimum are invalid.

allowed_license_use.description: Eligibility filter only; not legal advice or acceptance of a model license.

prefer_execution.description: Preference only. Runtime evidence determines actual offload; unsupported GPU use is never forced.

endpoint.description: First-stable supports only an unauthenticated loopback Ollama endpoint.

model_storage.description: Optional privacy-safe user path using ${HOME}. Service-specific storage is still discovered and verified.

existing_server_restart.description: An existing process/service is never restarted silently. There is deliberately no always value.

install_official_ollama_extension.description: The stable contract installs only Ollama.ollama and never marketplace-installs bundled Copilot Chat.

utility_model_guidance.description: Selection remains a supported UI handoff; this does not authorize undocumented profile edits.

safe_only.description: First-stable configuration cannot enable undocumented or destructive automatic repairs.

check_on_status.description: No update network request is made by status unless this is true or --check-updates is supplied.

verify_github_attestation_when_available.description: Use an already available gh executable; never install gh solely for attestation verification.

report.description: All report options remain constrained by the privacy allowlist; excluded data cannot be enabled by configuration.
